Metro Micro is currently offered in the following zones:

Watts/Compton
LAX/Inglewood
El Monte
North Hollywood
Pasadena/Altadena/Sierra Madre
Highland Park/Eagle Rock/Glendale
Northwest San Fernando Valley
UCLA/Westwood/Century City.
 

Find out more about Metro Micro at https://metro.net/micro
